scope: supplemental Mesh-specific source/runtime conformance evidence and acceptance detail; the repository-root GoreeCloud Platform Contract manifest is the platform-wide machine-readable declaration

source_contract_catalog.scope: authority metadata, expected contract-source discovery, and fail-closed source status inspection only; runtime conformance remains independently evidence-gated

evidence: GoreeCloud Manager remains the central administration and operational-management authority while Mesh remains the connectivity, reachability, discovery, and service-communication authority.
The repository documents the authority boundary explicitly and does not transfer Manager administrative authority into Mesh.
A direct Manager-to-Mesh operational integration remains planned and is not treated as implemented or Stable-gate-satisfied.
contracts/mesh.identity-verification.json defines the source-level GoreeCloud Identity verification boundary.
docs/identity-trust.md documents verified-principal metadata, scopes, issuer validation, and fail-closed protected-route behavior.
A deployed GoreeCloud Identity verifier and production credential mechanism remain pending and are not inferred from the source-level abstraction.
Mesh catalogs Glaze UI as the authority for design, interaction, accessibility, adaptive behavior, and visual presentation and points consumers to the Glaze UI conformance contract.
The standalone public Mesh website is a pinned Glaze UI 2.2.0 Stable consumer with its own source/deployment evidence boundary.
The platform-status view exposes missing product-interface Glaze UI runtime evidence as pending and not Stable-gate-satisfied rather than omitting or promoting it.
The administrative Mesh product interface is not yet complete or product-level runtime accepted.

Mesh catalogs Wardveil Security as the authority for security/protection status, evidence semantics, and protection presentation and records the canonical Wardveil status schema as the expected contract source.
The platform-status view joins Wardveil authority metadata only with bounded recorded evidence and fails closed when that evidence is missing or non-validated.

The source foundation defaults to loopback-only HTTP, fail-closed relationship policy, bounded JSON input, restrictive state-file permissions, explicit authority boundaries, and a source-level trust abstraction; approved Wardveil runtime adapter evidence remains pending.
Mesh catalogs GoreeCloud Privacy Shield as the privacy authority and records the platform privacy contract as the expected source for adapter/conformance integration.
The platform-status view preserves Privacy Shield evidence as a separate privacy-authority record and cannot infer privacy acceptance from adjacent Mesh or Wardveil state.

The architecture limits Mesh to minimized connectivity, discovery, relationship, and transport metadata; prohibits unnecessary application payload centralization; and includes source-level privacy/retention governance. Approved Privacy Shield runtime adapter and retention evidence remain pending.

Mesh catalogs Everkeep as the authority for resilience, recovery, preservation, portability, succession, and digital-legacy evidence and records the continuity status schema as the expected contract source.
docs/everkeep.adoption.json declares Mesh as a fail-closed producer-consumer of bounded continuity evidence without transferring Everkeep authority.
docs/everkeep.acceptance.json binds freshness, backup, restore, portability, documentation, provenance, and sensitive-evidence requirements while keeping Everkeep integration and readiness false.
The platform-status view keeps Everkeep source status fail-closed and does not treat durable state persistence as recovery acceptance.

The initial store uses atomic durable JSON persistence and source-level recovery readiness requires export, backup, restore, and verification evidence; production backup/export/restore and recovery acceptance remain pending.

The adopted eight-system architecture assigns synchronization, state coordination, event propagation, shared synchronization contracts, conflict handling, and cross-device continuity to GoreeCloud Sync rather than Mesh.

docs/architecture.md defines Mesh as the connectivity/reachability/service-communication authority and treats existing coordination-oriented Registry/Graph/Policy/Event source surfaces as transitional where they exceed that boundary.
No accepted Mesh-to-Sync runtime reachability/transport contract or production acceptance is claimed by the current source baseline.
